hints.title: Balanced Subarray Pivot Partition Obstacle
hints.text: Calculating the sum of elements to the left and right at each position independently requires quadratic total work. How can you calculate the grand total once and derive the right-hand sum from the left-hand accumulation in constant time?

hints.title: Complementary Sum Balance Invariant
hints.text: If left_sum is the sum strictly before index i, the sum strictly after index i is exactly total_sum minus left_sum minus nums[i]. Check when these two quantities match.

hints.title: Single Pass Running Sum Matching Procedure
hints.text: Compute total_sum across all elements. Initialize left_sum to zero. Traverse each element with index i: if left_sum equals total_sum minus left_sum minus nums[i], return i immediately. Otherwise add nums[i] to left_sum. Return negative one if no pivot is found.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: length of nums array (1 <= N <= 10^4)
complexity.notes: Single pass prefix balance comparison with constant O(1) extra space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Summing left and right partitions independently for all N indices takes O(N) work per index, leading to an O(N^2) bottleneck.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Computing total sum in an initial pass allows deriving right sum in O(1) time without extra memory buffers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Returning the leftmost index when multiple valid pivots exist, and correctly handling edge cases where pivot is index 0 or N-1.
